entities.name: CoaBC
observations: Bifunctional enzyme in bacterial coenzyme A biosynthesis; catalyzes EC 6.3.2.5 and EC 4.1.1.36.
The ligase step forms N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine from (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate, L-cysteine, and CTP, releasing CMP and diphosphate.
The decarboxylase step converts N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine to (R)-4'-phosphopantetheine and CO2.
Reviewed homolog annotations report one FMN per subunit and Mg2+ as cofactor/metal requirement.
